<p class="about-eyebrow">Why this exists</p>

<p class="about-hero-lead">
Most numerical methods are taught as a formula on a page — an update rule, an integral, a matrix. Visual Math Lab turns each one into something you can touch: move an input, and watch the algorithm think its way to an answer, one step at a time.
</p>

## How it works

Each page pairs the math with a live app: change a function, an interval, a seed, or a starting guess, and the plot, the step counter, and the iteration table all move together. Nothing here needs a server — every computation runs in your browser, so a page is just as fast and just as shareable as any static site.

## Built with

[Quarto](https://quarto.org), [Observable JS](https://observablehq.com), [Plotly.js](https://plotly.com/javascript/), and [math.js](https://mathjs.org) — no backend, no build step beyond rendering.
